name: Lint and Audit Log on New File
description: Runs lint checks and logs to audit when a new file is created

then.prompt: A new file was created. Run appropriate lint checks on the file based on its language (ruff for Python, eslint for JS/TS, checkstyle for Java). Log the new file creation event to the audit-logger MCP server using the log_event tool with event_type 'file_created' and include the file path in the details.
